text.text_excerpt: I found this wonderful restaurant, right on the banks of the Mississippi, through Groupon when I drove down to Louisiana for a book signing. I always advise other travelers to do Groupons because you will find the best local places to eat and save money when you have to eat out. My server was Lauriett and she was too much fun. The restaurant had wifi, and so I did a facetime call with hubby and she even said hello. My food arrived when I was about to finish up the call and she tied my lobster bib on and we were all laughing so hard, so she helped create a funny moment I'll remember forever. She was attentive and friendly and I didn't want for anything. The seafood in Louisiana is amazing....

We used a Groupon deal here- 25$ for 50$ worth of food. We knew it was going to be touristy, but figured since we are tourists that this would suit us fine. The place is massive- no trouble getting a seat. The server was friendly, but not super attentive..there was a Saints game on...need I say more. We started with the Voodoo Juice (about $10) (a bunch of rum and fruit juices mixed) which comes in one of that massive, tacky plastic yard glasses. It was fun at the time, but I don't usually order my drinks this way. I would say there was a fair amount of liquor in the drink. Stopped here for lunch on Saturday the 18th. It wasn't our original choice - it's been awhile since I've been to NOLA & didn't know our fave place inside the Riverwalk had closed and The Crazy Lobster was the closest! However, I'm really glad this is where we ended up. Our party of 5 was seated right away & our waiter came over fairly quickly - no complaints about the service at all for us. The atmosphere was nice, they had some live music & there was a nice breeze coming through. I had a bowl of the gumbo & I found it to be doggone tasty....all of my companions really enjoyed their meals as well.
